BiblicalUsage: Shoham was a son of Merari by Jaaziah, named once in the divisions of the Levites under David. He belongs to the Merarite line, the family charged with carrying the tabernacle's frames and sockets.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the men who carried the frames mattered as much as the men who carried the ark. Shoham's name stands in the Levite lists because his family held up the house of God.
